parameters.notes: Audio Baton. Each listed control was wheeled to both ends in the vendor panel and moved only its own byte; min/max are the raw limits seen. Raw units: no physical unit is claimed. Band 1-9 are the thumbwheels under the nine bars, left to right (wheeled to both ends); the bars only display. Unmapped bytes are written back unchanged. Read layout on this device: loaded alone into an empty rack through this project's server, the cat 0x07 reply was one flag byte then the block and nothing else (one instance per reply)
